subject: Literature
title: The Burning of the Library of Alexandria
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Burning of the Library of Alexandria.

hook.text: The Library of Alexandria held hundreds of thousands of scrolls and was the ancient world's greatest treasure of knowledge.

buildup.text: Scholars from across the Mediterranean gathered there to translate, debate, and preserve the wisdom of every culture.

discovery.text: The library was destroyed gradually over centuries by fires, neglect, and religious conflict, not a single dramatic blaze.

twist.text: Historians estimate that most ancient Greek literature, perhaps ninety percent, was lost forever in those destructions.

climax.text: Alexandria became the ultimate symbol of what humanity loses when knowledge is deliberately or carelessly destroyed.

punchline.text: We will never know what wisdom those lost scrolls held.

quiz.question: How was the Library of Alexandria actually destroyed?
options: Gradually over centuries through fires, neglect, and conflict
It was peacefully closed and all scrolls were relocated
